title: The Fox and the Crow
text:
Once there was a little fox. He lived in a forest near a river. Every day, he looked for food.

One day, the fox saw a crow in a tree. The crow had a big piece of cheese. The fox wanted the cheese, so he said, 'You have a beautiful voice!' The crow was happy, and she opened her mouth to sing. The cheese fell down, and the fox ate it.

options: In a forest near a river

questions.text: Why did the fox say the crow had a beautiful voice?
options: He wanted to learn to sing
He was angry at the crow

questions.text: What is the main lesson of the story?
options: Be careful of people who praise you only to get something
Food is more important than friends

vocabulary.definition: a large area with many trees

paragraph_translations: Era uma vez uma raposa pequena. Ele vivia em uma floresta perto de um rio. Todos os dias, ele procurava comida.

Um dia, a raposa viu um corvo em uma árvore. O corvo tinha um pedaço grande de queijo. A raposa queria o queijo, então disse: 'Você tem uma voz linda!' O corvo ficou feliz e abriu o bico para cantar. O queijo caiu, e a raposa o comeu.
